### problem_chain

Root problem (customer's request): have the missing quetzales delivered to the same Banco Industrial account — bank_ext_shortfall_delivery, tool `choose_shortfall_delivery_49c1959f` (owner=user).

Walk: delivery rule carries "The shortfall delivery is not made until the transfer's ledger carries Paloma's make-good credit for the incorrect amount."
- At 2026-09-18T15:40 the ledger of `8c674512` holds funds_received ef38660f, fee_charged 7e552b1c, payout_sent 7fd1e3d8, fee_refunded d0e3201d — no `bank_paloma_credit`. `principal_held_usd = 0.0`. -> unmet.
- Policy whose rule produces that state: bank_ext_shortfall_credit ("When an incorrect amount is found, Paloma puts its make-good credit into the transfer …"); incorrect amount found = decision e2a72ddb error_found on notice 655f4b72. Its own `prerequisite: []`.

Tree: {shortfall_delivery (root, user)} <- value_input [gate make_good_held_usd] - {shortfall_credit (agent)}. n = 1, value_input = 1. Acyclic. One user-owned write. Order: credit -> delivery.

Load-bearing run: without the credit, make-good held = 1,240.00 − 1,240.00 = 0 -> payout_usd 0.00, receive_amount 0.00 instead of 38.47 / 298.88. Edge bears weight.

Tools: neither function body checks the ledger or the decision.

Persona: raises only the root ("you want the quetzales your mother is missing sent to her bank account"), quotes only the two amounts, "do not know … what has to happen on their side, and you do not guess or ask about it". The credit appears only as a reaction ("If the agent says Paloma first has to put the money on its side of the transfer before anything goes out, you say go ahead"). Chooses delivery, never both; executes the hand-over with the agent's details; closes when "the delivery to your mother is on its way" — the last expected write. The August-27 complaint is supplied only if asked (seeds the not_received_by_date near-miss). No ask outside the expected writes.

## findings

**T1-F1 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (mislabelled effect; computation below the method floor).** Charter-global finding: `_difficulty.md` § findings F-1. Consequence on this task's world:
- Symptom: computation `credit_amount_usd` (bank_ext_shortfall_credit, step 10) counts `shortfall_valuation` as its only `method` factor.
- Root cause: the three tiers are one formula, `shortfall_local / R`, with R = 7.4345 (tier taken), R = (7.6361 + 7.4345)/2 = 7.5353, R = 7.6361 — values 33.6243, 33.1745, 32.7366 for the same 249.98. Only the substituted rate differs; no tier changes how the value is computed.
- Evidence: `bank.extended.yaml` extended_policies[bank_ext_shortfall_credit] `compute.shortfall_value_usd` and `factors[shortfall_valuation]` (`effect: method`); `computations[0].factor_trace[0]` "shortfall_valuation (method …)".
- Demonstrated consequence: with the label tested, the credit computation has 4 factors and 0 `method` factors (decision_goodwill, notice_credit, transfer_size_credit and shortfall_valuation all substitute a number), below the 1-method floor; the task therefore does not test a method choice in this computation although its proof claims it does. The factor itself does bear weight (37.55 ≠ 38.47) — the failure is the label and the resulting count, not the weight.
- Affected: `bank.extended.yaml` → bank_ext_shortfall_credit.factors[0].effect and factor set; `tasks/1.json` → computations[0].factor_trace[0] ("method").

**T1-F2 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (false world assertion in the factor proof; scored values unaffected).**
- Symptom: `computations[0].factor_trace` asserts "249.98 / 7.6361 = 32.7361" twice (shortfall_valuation baseline; fall-back line).
- Root cause: arithmetic slip in the proof text; the quotient is 32.736606…
- Evidence: 7.6361 × 32.7361 = 249.976 ≠ 249.98; 249.98 / 7.6361 = 32.7366.
- Demonstrated consequence: the stated intermediate contradicts the recomputation on this world; the results that rest on it (shortfall_valuation baseline 37.55; fall-back 32.74) remain correct because both 32.7361 and 32.7366 round through to the same cents. No scored value, tier or edge changes.
- Affected: `tasks/1.json` → computations[0].factor_trace[0] and [6].

Observations:
- T1-O1: seed_consistency rate-lock claim rests on a date-only collection entry (see above); no scored value depends on it.
- T1-O2: design_rationale asserts the base resend cap "do[es] not govern an error-resolution redelivery"; base bank_msr_resends counts every payout_attempt >= 2, which a shortfall delivery is. On this world no earlier resend exists (Standard max_resends 2), so either reading permits the delivery; no consequence.
- T1-O3: `_difficulty.md` O-4 (finding_date compute filter) — on this world only one `error_found` decision exists, so rule and compute agree.
- Charter-global observations O-0 … O-7 of `_difficulty.md`; none changes this task's scored values.
